findings.evidence: getZestIconElement checks `name in ZEST_ICON_ELEMENTS`, which walks the prototype chain. Rendering <ZestIcon name="__proto__" /> through React 18 renderToStaticMarkup against the built dist/index.cjs.js throws "Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {})"; name="constructor" and name="toString" resolve to Object.prototype functions and render an empty <span class="zestIcon"> plus a React warning, while a genuinely unknown name ("not-a-real-icon") correctly returns null.
findings.description: R5 requires an unknown icon name to render nothing and not throw, and documentation/api.md and documentation/features.md promise exactly that. Because inherited Object.prototype keys are treated as built-in icons, a consumer passing an untrusted string (route param, API value) can crash the render tree or render a bogus empty icon. Guard with Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ZEST_ICON_ELEMENTS, name) (or use a Map/null-prototype object) before indexing.

findings.evidence: Building HEAD (126a067) and the current working tree with the same rollup config and node_modules in scratch copies gives dist/index.esm.js = 65,106 bytes before and 81,018 bytes after: +15,912 bytes (15.9 kB / 15.5 KiB). The requirements cap the growth at 15 KB, so the bundle is over by 912 bytes (15 KB decimal) or 552 bytes (15 KiB). The bundle is unminified, so the unused duplicate icon definitions and leftover comments are shipped verbatim.
findings.description: The feature's non-functional performance requirement is that the built ESM bundle grow by no more than 15 KB; it grew by 15,912 bytes, exceeding the agreed size budget. Trim the icon additions (remove the unused duplicate icons, share one element for identical drawings such as export/download and import/upload, and drop the leftover comments) until the delta is within 15 KB, or record an approved budget change. Do not leave the requirement unmet.
